text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
That vaunted name has given us<n>countless legends
who made their<n>mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, Mejiro Ryan...

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer, and many more.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Their running is still fresh in the minds<n>of fans, who
continue to be drawn to<n>them.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Today, we look back on the history of<n>the Mejiro
family, featuring footage<n>from never-before-seen
interviews.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Fans have been eagerly awaiting the<n>rise of a new
Mejiro racer...
choice_data_list: The rise of a new Mejiro racer, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, my journey with Mejiro<n>Dober to take on
the Twinkle Series<n>begins!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's going to need to work harder<n>than ever if
she's to become the<n>rising star the world is
anticipating.
choice_data_list:
First things first, we need to discuss our plan going
forward!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I go to the training course to look for<n>Mejiro Dober,
and when I get there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Should be all warmed up now.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text: Wow! It's Mejiro Dober! She's as<n>cool as ever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Younger Student B
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't expect anything less from<n>a Mejiro.
They just have this aura<n>about them...

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for her debut race. I bet<n>it's gonna be
awesome! I wanna go<n>watch it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is attracting attention<n>from the
younger students. It looks<n>like expectations are
high within the<n>academy as well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Still, having this many eyes on her<n>might make her
nervous. I have to do<n>something before she gets
unnerved.
choice_data_list: Dober! Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer?! Don't just suddenly<n>shout my name!
And it's not like I<n>was waiting for you...
choice_data_list:
There are a lot of people here. Let's go talk
elsewhere.

There are a lot of people here. Let's go talk
elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. No worries, I just got<n>here.
choice_data_list:
There are a lot of people here. Let's go talk
elsewhere.

There are a lot of people here. Let's go talk
elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...O-okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Sure. Let's go.

Once we're away from the crowd, I<n>tell her I want
to talk about plans for<n>her debut.

Once we're away from the crowd, I<n>tell her I want
to talk about plans for<n>her debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, before we start... You were<n>trying to help me
back there, weren't<n>you? ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me back there. I<n>was honestly
feeling kind of<n>flustered, so I appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Actually, your timing works out. I<n>wanted to talk to
you about my debut<n>as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Actually, your timing works out. I<n>wanted to talk to
you about my debut<n>as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to run properly, to<n>become a racer
strong enough to run<n>with confidence at all times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And I want to start by putting<n>everything I've got
into my debut<n>race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just stating the obvious. I<n>wasn't fishing for
compliments.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-is it? All I did was state the obvious.<n>You don't
have to flatter me, you<n>know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, um, I just wanted to make<n>my intentions
clear, so... Let's make it<n>happen.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!
I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, um, I just wanted to make<n>my intentions
clear, so... Let's make it<n>happen.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!
I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sure. Anyway, about my training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Same here. Anyway, about my<n>training...
Dober!
Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff! I've been looking all overfor you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Bright, a ladylike and laid-back peer<n>of Dober's and
a fellow Mejiro, runs<n>up to us, waving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: There's a—eep!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student B
text_block_list.text:
That clumsy side of her just makes<n>me wanna
protect her! It's so<n>adorable!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text:
I totally understand. I kinda feel bad,<n>but seeing her
like this brings a smile<n>to my face...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear. My legs seem to have<n>gotten all tangled
up. This is no good.<n>No good at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Everyone seems to be<n>looking at
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good day, everyone! It's another<n>wonderful day
for training, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! Bright!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright carries herself with a<n>self-possessed
calm as she<n>addresses the younger students.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Some things never change...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, Dober. Apologies for<n>interrupting your
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
G-greetings. We haven't actually<n>started yet, so
it's no bother. Was<n>there something you wanted to
talk<n>about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since we're in the same year, I<n>thought I'd come to
give my<n>salutations and cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As racers of the Mejiro family, let us<n>forge through
the Twinkle Series<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. Let's work hard<n>together, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Motivated by Bright's words, Mejiro<n>Dober seems
more determined. I<n>have to take advantage of this.
choice_data_list:
Why not take this chance to do some partner
running?

Why not take this chance to do some partner
running?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? Now? I'm sure Bright has her<n>own training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a fabulous idea. I've<n>already finished
warming up, so why<n>don't we start right away?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, of course. I love running with<n>you, Dober. That
said...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Don't think I'll allow you to take the<n>lead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, unfortunately for you, I<n>don't plan on
letting you run ahead of<n>me either!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff! Puff! Huff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two sprint off under the clear sky,<n>their every
step filled with drive. It's<n>clear how much
motivation they<n>derive from each other.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! They're really going at it!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student B
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see how they do after<n>their debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! They look like they're having<n>loads of fun!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Seems they're well prepared for their<n>debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Hehe. I didn't expectanything less from you, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whew... You did great too, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can tell Mejiro Dober and Mejiro<n>Bright are going
to become great<n>rivals for each other!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's keep it up going into our debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right. I'll work hard so I can run at<n>my absolute
best!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I resolve to work hard too in order to<n>make her
powerful words come true.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thus begin my days of fighting<n>alongside Mejiro
Dober!
